description: This file contains unit tests for the LoraProtocolAdapter class, verifying its handling of provider routing, message processing, and error conditions within the Eclipse Hono LoRa adapter implementation.

classes.name: LoraProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of LoraProtocolAdapter, including message routing, handling different message types, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by creating a spy of LoraProtocolAdapter, mocking its methods, and setting default properties.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteSuccessfullyForUplinkMessage
methods.description: Test case: Verifies successful handling of an uplink message routing to a provider.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteSuccessfullyForOptionsRequest
methods.description: Test case: Verifies handling of an OPTIONS request routing.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsJoinMessages
methods.description: Test case: Ensures join messages are discarded and proper response is sent.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsDownlinkMessages
methods.description: Test case: Ensures downlink messages are discarded appropriately.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteDiscardsOtherMessages
methods.description: Test case: Ensures messages of unknown type are discarded.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesUnauthorizedForInvalidGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Test case: Checks that missing user credentials lead to unauthorized error.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Test case: Verifies response when device ID is missing in the message.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForMissingPayload
methods.description: Test case: Verifies response when payload extraction yields null.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestForInvalidPayload
methods.description: Test case: Ensures invalid payloads result in a bad request error.

methods.name: handleProviderRouteCausesBadRequestInCaseOfPayloadTransformationException
methods.description: Test case: Checks that malformed payloads cause a bad request response.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamMessageAddsProviderNameToMessage
methods.description: Verifies that the provider name is added as an application property in the downstream message.

methods.name: getLoraProviderMock
methods.description: Helper method to create a mock LoraProvider with preset return values for message extraction methods.

methods.name: getRoutingContextMock
methods.description: Helper method to create a mock RoutingContext with a predefined user, response, and provider attribute.

methods.name: verifyUnauthorized
methods.description: Helper to verify that the context fails with an unauthorized error code.

methods.name: verifyBadRequest
methods.description: Helper to verify that the context fails with a bad request error code.

methods.name: verifyErrorCode
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the context failed with a specific HTTP error code.
